iLand includes an embedded Javascript scripting engine that allows you
to automate tasks, script custom disturbances, evaluate stand state, and
configure the Agent-Based Management Engine (ABE).

This reference documentation is automatically parsed from the source
code, organizing the scripting API into three main sections:

### API Modules

:::::::::::: grid

:::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm}
::: card-body
#### [iLand Core API](classes/iland/iland.qmd)

Classes for automating model execution and accessing spatial
grid/tree-level states.

\* [Globals](classes/iland/globals.qmd) — Helper utilities and core
model control

\* [Grid](classes/iland/grid.qmd) — 2D spatial grid operations

\* [Tree](classes/iland/tree.qmd) — Individual tree-level inspection
:::
::::
:::::

::::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
:::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm}
::: card-body
#### [Agent-Based Management (ABE)](classes/abe/abe.qmd)

Core classes to script customized agents, activities, and stand
treatment programs.

\* [FMEngine](classes/abe/fmengine.qmd) — Main entry point for ABE
scripting

\* [Stand](classes/abe/stand.qmd) — Properties of forest stands

\* [TreeList](classes/abe/treelist.qmd),
[SaplingList](classes/abe/saplinglist.qmd),
[DeadTreeList](classes/abe/deadtreelist.qmd) — Act on ecosystem
components
:::
::::
:::::

::::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
:::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm}
::: card-body
#### [ABE Library](classes/abe-library/abe-lib.qmd)

A set of pre-defined building blocks for thinning, planting, and
harvesting.

\* [helper](classes/abe-library/helper.qmd) — Utilities to construct and
inspect STPs

\* [thinning](classes/abe-library/thinning.qmd) — Thinning block
operations

\* [harvest](classes/abe-library/harvest.qmd) — Harvesting block
operations
:::

### Scripting Overview

For a broader introduction on how to use JavaScript within iLand,
including running scripts, time events, and expressions, please refer to
the general scripting guides:

-   [**Scripting Overview**](../wiki/scripting.qmd): Introduction to

-   [**General Scripting in iLand**](../wiki/iland-scripting.qmd):
